report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia izquierda
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales sin lesiones significativas.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que
impresiona contactar de manera periférica la superficie articular inferior, que puede representar
una pequeña rotura, no desplazada. Discreto edema de las partes blandas perimeniscales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos secundarios de distribución difusa de la
articulación patelofemoral.
Leve derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Signos sugerentes de una rotura periférica del menisco medial con edema de las partes blandas
regionales, correlacionar con clínica.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 de la articulación patelofemoral.
Leve derrame articular

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones difusas en la señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos, de grosor y señal normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal normales, sin evidencia de roturas.
Discreta irregularidad superficial del cartílago en zona de carga y central del cóndilo femoral
medial. Restantes cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales de espesor conservado, sin
otras lesiones focales significativas.
Irregularidad difusa del cartílago articular en el compartimento patelofemoral con extensas úlceras
de espesor parcial y total, estas últimas en el vértice y faceta lateral de la rótula asociado a focos
de edema óseo subcondrales así como también en la zona central de la vertiente lateral troclear.
Impresionan de discreta mayor extensión respecto a estudio previo.
Leve derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo de 6 mm, sin complicaciones evidentes.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, bíceps femoral, pata de ganso y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal normales.
Grasa de Hoffa aumentada de señal en su aspecto superoexterno.
Articulación tibioperonea proximal sin alteraciones.
Impresión:
Condropatía difusa patelofemoral, grado 4, de discreta mayor extensión respecto a estudio previo.
Condropatía superficial focal en el aspecto central del cóndilo femoral medial, grado 1-2.
Leve derrame articular.
Signos de hiperpresión patelar externa.
Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rotura meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar
con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Aumento de señal de la raíz meniscal posterior y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral sugieren una
rotura con leve extrusión meniscal.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la región central y posterior de platillo tibial lateral,
sin cambios óseos secundarios. En tórax condrales de espesor parcial del cóndilo femoral lateral.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial medial y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos secundarios de distribución difusa de la
rótula.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales. Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tercio
proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Mínimo derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Impresión:
Signos de una rotura degenerativa de la raíz meniscal posterior y parte del cuerno posterior del
menisco lateral con mínima extrusión meniscal.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 de platillo tibial lateral y grado 2 del cóndilo femoral lateral.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 4 de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular con mínima sinovitis.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal

The study reveals narrowing of the medial tibiofemoral joint, with full thickness cartilage loss at weightbearing part of the medial femoral condyle, about 1.6x2.3cm.,  and severe chondrosis at tibial plateau, with mild subchondral bone edema.   
    Mild medial bulging medial meniscus with myxoid change,  without meniscal tear is observed.   MCL is intact.  
   FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.  Lateral meniscus is not torn.   
     Diffuse chondrosis of the lateral femoral condyle and tibial plateau is observed.  
  Normal orientation of ACL with intact ligament fiber is observed.   PCL is intact.  
  Thinning articular cartilage with illdefined hyperintense lesions along medial and lateral PF joint are noted.   
  Small marginal osteophytes along medial and lateral tibiofemoral and PF joint are observed.  
    Minimal amount of joint effusion and fluid distended suprapatellar bursa with mild thickened synovial tissue are seen.  
   The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.     Full thickness cartilage loss at weightbearing part of the medial femoral condyle, about 1.6x2.3cm.,grade 4 chondropathy, and severe chondrosis at medial tibial plateau, 
      Diffuse chondrosis of the lateral tibiofemoral joint 
      Grade 3 chondrosis of the PF joints, with evidence of PF synovitis and suprapatellar bursitis 
  
         Secondary OA change of the knee and PF joint,  
  
  Myxoid degenerative change of medial meniscus without tear

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m.
kvadricepsa.
Plitka radijalna ruptura korpusa medijalnog meniska, koja prema stražnjem rogu postaje
subtotalna.
Potpuna radijalna ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog mensika s flap komponentom koja se odvaja
od stražnjeg roga prema interkondilarnoj udubini.
Ruptura prednjeg križnog ligamenta, uz MR znakova anteroposteriorne nestabilnosti.
Gotovo potpuni gubitak hrskavice lateralnog kondila femura i tibije s blažim subhondrlanim
koštanim edemom - OA promjene.
Raslojavanje do polovice debljine hrskavice lateralne fasete patele (hondromalacija 3. stupnja
prema ICRS klasifikaciji) - OA promjene.
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Izljev u koljenu, poplitealna (Bakerova) cista.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Prikaže se iregularna hrskavica medijalnog kondila femura, značajno reducirane debljine te
promijenjenog intenziteta signala uz vidljive fisure, izražen subhondralni koštani edem i sitne
subhondralne ciste medijalnog kondila femura - hondromalacija IV°. U središnjem i posteriornom
dijelu medijalnog kondila mogući manji osteohondralni defekti (promjera do 5 mm, tip IIa).
Promijenjen intenzitet signala hrskavice medijalnog tibijalnog platoa - hondromalacija I/II°.
Promijenjen intenzitet signala medijalnog meniska uz kompleksnu rupturu u području tijela i
stražnjeg roga te ekstruziju za oko 3 mm i kranijalnu migraciju.
Distenzija medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta uz suspektnu parcijalnu rupturu meniskofemoralnog
ligamenta.
Održana je debljina hrskavica lateralnog dijela FT zgloba. Hrskavice promijenjenog intenziteta
signala - hondromalacija I° stupnja.
Promijenjen intenzitet signala lateralnog meniska u smislu degenerativnih promjena, bez znakova
rupture.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Povišen intenzitet signala prednjeg križnog ligamenta, održanog kontinuiteta u smislu
degenerativnih promjena.
Stražnji križni ligament je blaže degenerativo promijenjen, održanog kontinuiteta.
Wiberg III tip patele. Hondromalacija IV° lateralne fasete patele uz formirane sitne subhodralne
ciste/manje zone koštanog edema. Trohlearna hrskavica primjerene morfologije.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Blago povišen intenzitet signala na hvatištu iliotibijalnog trakta za tibiju u smislu entezopatskih
promjena.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa i pes anserinus.
Povišen intenzitet signala ligamenta patele na hvatištu za patelu uz formirane osteofite u smislu
entezopatskih promjena.
Tetiva kvadricepsa primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Umjereni izljev u zglobu uz blagu do umjerenu proliferaciju sinovije.
Baker cista aksijalno veličine oko 27x14 mm uz blaži edem okolnih mekih tkiva - moguće stanje
nakon rupture.
Potkožni edem difuzno. Varikoziteti sliva VSM.

In the medial compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior hornroot of the medial meniscus. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the medial gutter. There is diffuse high grade chondrosis (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is subchondral edema. Multiple subchondral bone cysts (about intact3intact7 cm) are identified. Osteophytes are present.  
 The lateral compartment, the lateral meniscus is not torn. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Small osteophytes are present.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis at medial trochlea. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. Tendinopathy of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present.  
 There is severe fatty muscle infiltration of the soleus, medial, lateral head gastrocnemius muscles.  Medial and lateral tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the left knee, predominantly at the medial joint by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes.  
  Diffuse low grade chondrosis at medial trochlea.  
  Radial tear at the posterior hornroot of the medial meniscus. (note: meniscal extrusion into the medial gutter).  
  Tendinopathy of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon.  
  Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis. 
  Severe fatty muscle infiltration of the soleus, medial, lateral head gastrocnemius muscles.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain; [REDACTED]; pain and swelling at the medial aspect of the knee
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. There is a stress fracture of the medial tibial plateau with curvilinear low signal intensity in the subcortical bone measuring up to 1.0 cm anterior posterior by 0.9 cm mediolateral dimension with surrounding marrow edema. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate-to-large joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Minute Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex medial meniscal tears including an oblique component at the posterior horn extending to the free edge. Tears at the undersurface of the body, with subluxation of the body into the medial gutter measuring 2 mm. Subtle high signal intensity at the anterior aspect of the body approximating the superior articular surface.
Medial compartment cartilage: Broad-based area of grade 4 chondrosis along the central the anterior weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle extending over 1.0 cm mediolateral dimension, and up to 1.9 cm anterior posterior dimension. Diffuse thinning of the cartilage of the medial tibial plateau with areas of up to grade 3 chondrosis medially.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Mild intrasubstance heterogeneous signal intensity in the body without definite tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Scattered areas of up to grade 2/3 chondrosis at the medial patellar facet measuring up to 0.5 cm mediolateral dimension. Grade 2/3 chondrosis in the medial trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact with mild subsidence heterogeneous signal intensity.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Mild to moderate sprain of the medial collateral ligament with focal thickening and heterogeneous signal intensity at the proximal fibers, and edema surrounding the mid to distal fibers.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Edema in the popliteus muscle belly. Otherwise unremarkable.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Attenuation of the posterior fibers with surrounding soft tissue swelling.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt without translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Edema is noted in the popliteus muscle. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

Significant abnormality: This examination demonstrates an abnormality/anomaly that warrants follow-up or additional medical care within 3 months. [REDACTED]. (96)

IMPRESSION:

1. Stress fracture of the medial tibial plateau measuring approximately 0.9 x 1.0 cm with surrounding marrow edema.

2. Complex medial meniscal tears of the posterior horn and body with inferior and medial subluxation of the body into the medial gutter.

3. Mild to moderate sprain of the medial collateral ligament with surrounding edema.

4. Moderate to advanced medial compartment osteoarthritis with areas of to grade 4 chondrosis in the medial femoral condyle.

5. Moderate patellofemoral osteoarthritis with areas of grade 2/3 chondrosis.

6. Moderate to large joint effusion.

COMMUNICATION FOLLOW-UP: Documentation of communications managed and recorded in Si.
